extDesc.message: Capture browser downloads and send them to the local Rdown manager (HTTP/BT/magnet/m3u8 streams)

menuPage.message: Download all links on this page with Rdown

optServersHint.message: Match download URL + filename in order; first hit receives the task. A rule of * (or empty) marks the default server; the first row is the final fallback.

optSniffMedia.message: Sniff media resources on web pages (video / audio / m3u8) and list them in the popup

optAllowExternal.message: Allow download requests from other extensions (middleware API, enable with caution)

deepSearchBtn.description: Deep search button in the popup

mediaPreview.description: Preview button of a media list item

previewFailed.message: Preview failed: cannot load this media (login or hotlink protection may be required)

optDeepSearch.message: Deep search: scan scripts and player variables for media URLs after page load (can also be triggered manually from the popup)

optSniffRules.message: Sniff URL filter (one wildcard or /regex/ per line; empty = accept all)

optSniffRulesHint.message: Only URLs matching a rule enter the sniff list; * matches any characters, ? matches one character

optTemplateHint.message: Variables: ${title} page title, ${fileName} original filename without extension, ${ext} extension, ${host} site host, ${date} date (YYYYMMDD)

optAutoDownload.message: Auto-download sniffed media (except m3u8 live streams; each URL is sent only once)

optAutoDownloadMinSize.message: Minimum size for auto-download (MB; smaller files are not auto-downloaded)

optAskBeforeDownload.message: Ask for confirmation before download (filename, split and target server editable)

openPanelBtn.description: Manager panel button in the popup

stateConnected.description: Popup footer status: connected, $1 is the server URL (may include name)

stateFailed.description: Popup footer status: connection failed, $1 is the error message

noLinksFound.message: No downloadable links found on this page

batchResult.description: Batch download result, $1 is the success count, $2 is the failure part (batchResultFail or empty)

batchResultFail.description: Failure part of the batch download result, $1 is the failure count

optServerUrlHint.message: Rdown backend URL, default http://127.0.0.1:16801 (used when the server list below is empty)

optApiTokenHint.message: If the backend "Settings → API Token" is set, enter the same token here

optEnabled.message: Capture browser downloads to Rdown (shortcut Alt+Shift+D)

optDomainList.message: Domain list (one per line, * wildcard supported)

optDomainListHint.message: Matches both the page domain and the download file domain; * matches any characters

optExtList.message: Extension list (separated by commas or spaces)

optExtListHint.message: m3u8 / mpd stream URLs are always captured, regardless of the extension filter

optCaptureUnknownSize.message: Capture even when the size is unknown

optCaptureMagnet.message: Capture magnet links (magnet:) directly when clicked

optNotifyComplete.message: Show a system notification when a download completes / fails

optAltBypassHint.message: Hold Alt while clicking a download to temporarily bypass capture

testSuccess.description: Test connection success, $1=aria2 status, $2=aria2 version, $3=stream engine, $4=ffmpeg

statusFailed.description: Test connection failed, $1 is the error message

importFailed.description: Config import failed, $1 is the error message

langHint.message: The extension reloads automatically to apply the new language to all UI
langHint.description: Hint: the extension reloads after changing the language

langApplied.description: Status shown right before the extension reloads

extShortName.description: Short name of the extension (max 12 chars)

obWelcomeSub.message: Automatically intercepts browser downloads and sends them to the local Rdown download manager for high-speed downloading.

obTestFail.message: Please start the Rdown backend first

obPinStep1.message: Click the puzzle icon (Extensions) on the right side of the browser toolbar

obPinStep2.message: Find Rdown in the list and click the pin icon to pin it

obDemoDesc.message: Open the built-in demo page, click a download link, and watch the extension send the task to Rdown.

obDemoHint.message: Click a download link on the page and watch the extension take over

obDoneDesc.message: All set. You can close this page now.
